router.name: Vibhu-Oska Task/Target Router
router.training_notes: best_router.pt loaded by OrchestratorCore at startup. Router predicts task/target; under strict protocol primary workloads still route to Karsh first.

reasoning.name: Karsh (Custom Transformer)
reasoning.quality_gate: Checkpoint must exceed 1MB and pass coherence checks (>=50 chars, >=8 real words, no token noise) in CognitionCore.generate_karsh.
reasoning.training_notes: Run: python -m Models.karsh.train --epochs 60 --batch 8 --lr 0.0003 (CPU-friendly: reduce epochs/hidden via --flags). Corpus is preserved by seed_default_corpus (append-safe).

backup.name: BackupCore LocalSLM (Contingency)
backup.training_notes: Strict contingency layer. Activated by HybridCore ONLY on primary fault, timeout, or capacity overflow. Falls back to ContextAwareTemplateEngine when no weights present.

fast_responder.name: FastResponder (Primary Fast Path)
fast_responder.training_notes: Primary-path instant responder. Never carries contingency workloads; BackupCore remains strict contingency only.

version_history.notes: Initial registry — router reported untrained; reasoning referenced external QLoRA stack (superseded).
Reconciled with actual architecture: router trained (best_val_acc=1.0), reasoning = Karsh from scratch, backup = LocalSLM contingency, added FastResponder primary-path engine.
